rules_shown.rule: When the target object must be found, never open cabinets or drawers first; scan the bathtubbasin and countertops first.
rules_shown.example: Agent wasted time opening multiple cabinets without finding the cloth, which was in the bathtubbasin.
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Corrected Error] When the target object must be found, never open cabinets or drawers first; scan the bathtubbasin and countertops first. Example: Agent wasted time opening multiple cabinets without finding the cloth, which was in the bathtubbasin.

rules_shown_to: planner (as the "rules" field of its prompt, before it writes subgoals) and actor (as the block "Rules learned from earlier practice (follow them)" in every step prompt); one set chosen once from the goal
shows: Clean task where the manual does not help: the agent runs in circles (`go to diningtable 1` is invalid six times in a row) before it finds the tomato, and still wins in 28 steps. C won the same game in 10.
why_interesting: Honest counter-example: the rules cannot fix a search problem when the object is hidden; E can be slower. Win rate hides step count.
